answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 30998 Country: NP Title: RECENTLY THROUGH ONE OF MY FRIEND I WAS INFORMED THAT QURBANI OF BUFFALO IS NOT LEGAL(JAIJ). PLEASE REPLY ME THAT BUFALLO QURBANI IS O.K. OR NOT? Question: RECENTLY THROUGH ONE OF MY FRIEND I WAS INFORMED THAT QURBANI OF BUFFALO IS NOT LEGAL(JAIJ). PLEASE REPLY ME THAT BUFALLO QURBANI IS O.K. OR NOT? Answer ID: 30998 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 501/501/M=1432) If the buffalo is two year old and it does not have a defect preventing the validity of its Qurbani, then performing qurbani of it is alright without any doubt. Your friend told you wrong ruling. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
